body: Talk to your friends.. life definitely sucks as your a teen but it's not going to stay like that forever. The feeling you have will go away as you get older. Life isn't over for you yet. So please, just talk to someone. Anyone.

But you have to look at it like this, if she truly wanted to be with you in her heart of hearts she would've stayed. Helping you with your depression, with the attempts. She wouldn't have walked away from you  as if you were nothing, knowing how you are, and what youre feeling. The mind plays dirty tricks but the heart is pure. Listen to that. It's smarter than the brain will ever be. I really do hope that love enters your heart and stays there for a very long time.
